cards.meaning: in short; to sum up — introduces a concluding statement
cards.example: 总之，只要收益率不回落，风险资产就很难喘口气。
cards.examplePinyin: zǒng zhī, zhǐ yào shōu yì lǜ bù huí luò, fēng xiǎn zī chǎn jiù hěn nán chuǎn kǒu qì
cards.exampleMeaning: In short, as long as yields don't come down, risk assets will struggle to catch a breath.
cards.note: Both written and spoken register, but especially common in news/finance broadcasting to snap a long analysis into one takeaway. More formal near-synonym: 总而言之 (zǒng ér yán zhī) — same meaning, heavier and more literary; 总之 is the natural spoken choice. Common pattern: 总之，重点是…… ('in short, the point is...').

cards.meaning: to trigger, spark, give rise to (a chain reaction — usually an event, emotion, or reaction)
cards.example: 收益率飙升，直接引发了芯片股的抛售。
cards.examplePinyin: shōu yì lǜ biāo shēng, zhí jiē yǐn fā le xīn piàn gǔ de pāo shòu
cards.exampleMeaning: The yield spike directly triggered a sell-off in chip stocks.
cards.note: Near-synonym contrast with 导致 (dǎo zhì, 'to cause/lead to'): 导致 is neutral and takes any result, good or bad; 引发 carries a sense of 'igniting' something, and almost always pairs with an event or emotion — 引发担忧 (spark worry), 引发争议 (spark controversy), 引发关注 (draw attention). You'd say 这个政策引发了热烈的讨论, not 导致了热烈的讨论 — 引发 has that spark.
cards.tiesTo: yield spike triggering the chip-stock sell-off

cards.meaning: genuine, heartfelt kindness or magnanimity — goodness that comes from one's inner self
cards.example: Ang kabutihang-loob nila ay talagang kahanga-hanga, hindi nila kailangang gawin iyon, pero ginawa nila nang buo ang puso.
cards.exampleMeaning: Their inner goodness was truly admirable — they didn't have to do it, but they did it wholeheartedly.
cards.note: Native-speaker nuance: deeper than the everyday word for kindness, 'kabaitan,' which can just mean politeness or being pleasant. 'Kabutihang-loob' is built on 'loob,' the inner self — a core concept in Filipino values — so it specifically marks unprompted, unrewarded generosity, not just courtesy. It's the word for someone who goes well beyond what duty required.

cards.meaning: to go into a business partnership or venture together
cards.example: Maharlika ay maaaring makipagsosyo sa mga dayuhang kumpanya para sa Pax Silica hub sa New Clark City.
cards.exampleMeaning: Maharlika may go into partnership with foreign companies for the Pax Silica hub in New Clark City.
cards.note: From 'sosyo,' a business partner or associate — so 'pagsosyo' is specifically forming a commercial partnership, close to the English 'joint venture,' carrying a sense of shared capital, shared risk, and shared profit. More specific than 'pakikipagtulungan,' the general word for 'cooperation,' which doesn't necessarily involve money changing hands.
cards.tiesTo: Maharlika Investment Corp as a JV partner for the Pax Silica chip hub
